tailoring.headline: AI-Focused SAP Commerce Cloud Engineer | Java, Spring, REST APIs, AI-Assisted Development
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, micro-services, and data integration between PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven track record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, performance tuning, and AI-assisted analysis and documentation. Strong techno-functional consulting experience with international stakeholders.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SQLI AI Architect
cover_en.hook: I am excited to apply for the SQLI AI Architect role, where I can combine my deep SAP Commerce Cloud expertise with AI-assisted development. With over five years building and integrating large-scale e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have delivered robust Java-Spring back-ends, API strategies and data pipelines that drive digital transformation.

bullets.label: AI-Assisted Development
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I leveraged generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, code generation and documentation, reducing development time while maintaining high quality.

bullets.label: API & Integration Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented OCC REST services and end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines, integrating SAP ERP and MDM systems, ensuring seamless product data flow across global channels.

bullets.label: Cloud-Native Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) using Docker and Kubernetes, delivering reliable cloud-native releases and improving deployment frequency.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into functional specifications and user stories, guiding teams through PI planning and agile delivery.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to SQLI.

tailoring.why_company: SQLI is a leading digital transformation partner that blends cutting-edge AI with commerce expertise to create innovative customer experiences. Your commitment to AI-driven solutions and scalable e-commerce platforms matches my background in AI-assisted SAP Commerce development, data integration and cloud-native delivery. I am eager to help SQLI accelerate its AI initiatives and strengthen its commerce portfolio for global clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join SQLI to apply my AI-enhanced SAP Commerce expertise to your innovative digital commerce projects and drive measurable business impact.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud engineer with AI-assisted development experience. I’m excited about SQLI’s AI-driven commerce vision and would love to discuss how I can add value. Let’s connect!
tailoring.offer: In my first months at SQLI I will modernize your SAP Commerce Cloud backend by implementing AI-enhanced OCC APIs and optimizing PIM-ERP data pipelines, leveraging my proven CI/CD and Kubernetes expertise. This will accelerate time-to-market for new digital services while ensuring high performance and scalability.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SQLI AI Architect – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud engineer with 5+ years delivering AI-assisted e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell. SQLI’s focus on AI-driven digital transformation aligns perfectly with my experience in AI-enhanced development, API architecture and cloud-native deployments. I can immediately add value by modernizing your commerce backend, integrating PIM/ERP data and accelerating releases through CI/CD and Kubernetes. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
